blocks.text: NAGOYA—Matching the Philippines’ medal haul from the previous Asian Para Games was always going to be difficult, especially with chess—the country’s biggest source of gold medals three years ago—removed from the competition calendar. But the Filipino athletes still delivered a performance worth celebrating, collecting two golds, two silvers and three bronzes to finish 17th overall […]...
